mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the irises was most worthwhile because the resulting ray diagram explained how the cornea, lens and iris contribute to getting light to the retina.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the corneas and lenses involved predictable, separate steps with little feedback until the later explanation.

surprise.text: The distinction between light entering the eye and nerve signals leaving the retina clarified what the visual pathway carries.

arbitrary.text: The required order for connecting the eyes to the body before adding their moving muscles was not obvious from the item descriptions, though compatibility feedback allowed progress.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it connects the constructed body to a new function; the signal pathway was interesting, although the repeated fittings were less engaging.
